d:
Pakistan ke sena pramukh aur phild marshal aasim munir ne somvar ko maleshiya ke pradhanmantri anvar ibrahim se mulakat ki, jisse donon deshon ke bich sanbhavit diphens partanarship ko lekar charcha shuru ho gaee.
Pakistani sena ke intar sarvis pablik rileshans (aaeeespiaar) ke mutabik, phild marshal aasim munir ki maleshiya ki aadhikarik yatra ka maksad donon deshon ke bich raksha aur sainy sahyog ko aur majbut karna tha.
Aasim munir ki is yatra se yah saval khara hota hai ki kya muslim deshon ke bich raksha sajhedari se jura koee naya chalan dekhne ko mil raha hai?
